title: French Paillote Crusted Snapper
description: A simple and flavorful dish featuring a crispy paillote crust on a delicate snapper, served with a side of sautéed wheat
instructions: Season the snapper fillets with salt and Brazilian spices.
Dredge the fillets in whole wheat flour, shaking off excess.
Dip the floured fillets in the paillote, pressing gently to coat.
Heat the nutty oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the paillote-crusted snapper for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Meanwhile, sauté the wheat in a separate pan with a squeeze of snappy lemon juice.
Serve the snapper with the sautéed wheat and a side of steamed vegetables.
Garnish with additional Brazilian spices, if desired.
